newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices lose gains, arrivals rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices lose gains, arrivals rise.

text.p: Indian cotton prices on Friday lost some recent gains on low demand and new crop arrivals, dealers said.
But scattered support from the Cotton Corporation of India arrested a sharp fall in the prices, one broker said.
Spot deals Bengal-deshi (ready delivery) fell to 950/1,000 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) from 990/1,070 rupees. Punjab saw-ginned eased to 1,635/1,690 rupees from 1,660/1,730 rupees.
Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) slid by 200 rupees to 20,500/21,000 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
